title: Fourier coefficient as an expectation
statement: Let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ and $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Its vector Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ equals the uniform expectation over $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$ of $f(x)$ times the Walsh character associated with the support of $\gamma$, evaluated at $x$.
